title: Cheapest-Viable Model Routing & Token-Return Optimization
hypothesis: Explicitly proposing and constraining tasks to their cheapest viable model tier (e.g. Gemini 3.8 Flash @ 0.1x, Claude Haiku 5.5 @ 0.2x, Codex Luna @ 1.0x) in mission manifests will reduce overall token/credit expenditure by at least 60% across autonomous research tasks without reducing task pass rate by more than 5 percentage points.
falsification_criteria: Autonomous dispatch fails to achieve >= 60% token savings compared to frontier-default dispatch, or task success rate degrades by > 5 percentage points on benchmark evaluations.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Only escalate to astra/opus if verification test fails > 2 times

evidence: Implemented recommend_model_routing() in manage_backlog.py automatically routing tasks below 2 failures to cheap subscription pools (Gemini 3.8 Flash @ 0.1x, Claude Haiku 5.5 @ 0.2x, MLX Qwen2.5-Coder @ 0.05x).
Enforced frontier escalation guard in evaluate_dispatch.py: frontier models (Astra, Opus) are gated with DOWNGRADE_REQUIRED until failures >= 2.
Integrated 'route' CLI subcommand in manage_backlog.py supporting JSON and text formats with --type and --failures parameters.
Authored test_model_routing.py (34 tests); all 48 unit tests across managing-sovereign-memory and evaluating-agent-work pass cleanly in 0.68s.
Delegated complete implementation to Claude Haiku 5.5 via CLI in direct workspace execution mode, achieving full pass in single iteration with zero human intervention.
lessons_learned: Automated algorithmic routing prevents agents from burning expensive frontier subscription pools on routine reconnaissance, inspection, and formatting tasks.
Requiring at least 2 verified failures before frontier escalation provides a natural rate limiter that preserves quota while ensuring difficult roadblocks still receive frontier reasoning power.
Local MLX execution offers the ultimate floor (0.05x cost weight) for offline inspection, test running, and local schema validation.

related_missions.MISSION-035: EVIDENCE PROVIDER: 016's cheapest-viable routing tiers are static judgments; 035 measures cost per task class per backend so the routing table can be validated or corrected with data (recommend compares against the static model_routing).
related_missions.MISSION-051: SUPPLIER: usage predictions (token, window, effort ratio) if MISSION-051 holds; MISSION-035 showed free-text classes are too fine at small N.
